'''Terlyn's husband''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] male, who was a member of the [[Council of Lords]] in [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. He was a strong supporter of Queen [[Talia (Onderon)|Talia]] and the Republic. Over time he became convinced that [[General/Legends|General]] [[Vaklu]] was trying to kill the Queen. He had tried to kill Vaklu to protect Queen Talia, but was shot and killed by Vaklu's troops.
